 143: 
 144:     function fundInventory(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
 145:         if (amount == 0) revert InsufficientInventory();
 146:         uint256 beforeBalance = omr.balanceOf(address(this));
 147:         omr.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
 148:         if (omr.balanceOf(address(this)) - beforeBalance != amount) revert InsufficientInventory();
 149:         availableInventory += amount;
 150:         emit InventoryFunded(msg.sender, amount);
 151:     }
 152: 
 153:     function setPaused(bool value) external {
 154:         if (msg.sender != safe) revert Unauthorized();
 155:         paused = value;
 156:         emit PauseSet(value);
 157:     }
 158: 
 159:     /// @notice Nontransferable receipts bind beneficiary and nonce; exact retry cannot reserve twice.
 160:     /// Slippage and expected epoch bind a purchase to a concrete published quote. No signature
 161:     /// grants inventory or issuance authority; finite aggregate limits apply across all buyers.
 162:     function purchase(uint64 expectedEpoch, uint256 minimumOmr, uint64 deadline, bytes32 nonce)
 163:         external
 164:         payable
 165:         nonReentrant
 166:         returns (bytes32 id, uint256 amount)
 167:     {
 168:         if (paused) revert Paused();
 169:         if (
 170:             nonce == bytes32(0) || deadline < block.timestamp || deadline > block.timestamp + 5 minutes
 171:                 || msg.value < minNativePurchase || msg.value > maxNativePurchase || minimumOmr == 0
 172:         ) revert InvalidQuote();
 173:         IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory s = _observation(expectedEpoch);
 174:         id = keccak256(abi.encode(block.chainid, address(this), msg.sender, nonce));
 175:         if (notes[id].beneficiary != address(0)) revert Replay();
 176:         amount = _price(msg.value, s.omrPerEth);
 177:         if (amount < minimumOmr) revert InvalidQuote();
 178:         if (s.epoch < lastPurchaseEpoch || s.observedAt < lastPurchaseObservedAt) revert InvalidObservation();
 179:         if (s.epoch > lastPurchaseEpoch) {
 180:             // The epoch is trusted only as a unique published observation. Time cannot regress.
 181:             if (lastPurchaseEpoch != 0 && s.observedAt <= lastPurchaseObservedAt) revert InvalidObservation();
 182:             epochNativePurchased = 0;
 183:             epochOmrPurchased = 0;
 184:             lastPurchaseEpoch = s.epoch;
 185:             lastPurchaseObservedAt = s.observedAt;
 186:         }
 187:         if (
 188:             amount > maxOmrPerPurchase || nativePurchased + msg.value > maxNativeLifetime
 189:                 || omrPurchased + amount > maxOmrLifetime || epochNativePurchased + msg.value > maxNativePerEpoch
 190:                 || epochOmrPurchased + amount > maxOmrPerEpoch
 191:         ) revert BudgetExceeded();
 192:         if (amount > availableInventory) revert InsufficientInventory();
 193:         availableInventory -= amount;
 194:         outstandingClaims += amount;
 195:         proceedsOwed += msg.value;
 196:         nativePurchased += msg.value;
 197:         omrPurchased += amount;
 198:         epochNativePurchased += msg.value;
 199:         epochOmrPurchased += amount;
 200:         uint64 end = uint64(block.timestamp + vestingSeconds);
 201:         notes[id] = Note(msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), end, uint128(amount), 0);
 202:         emit Purchased(id, msg.sender, s.epoch, msg.value, amount, end);
 203:     }
 204: 
 205:     function quote(uint256 nativeAmount, uint64 expectedEpoch) external view returns (uint256 amount) {
 206:         if (nativeAmount < minNativePurchase || nativeAmount > maxNativePurchase) revert InvalidQuote();
 207:         return _price(nativeAmount, _observation(expectedEpoch).omrPerEth);
 208:     }
 209: 
 210:     /// @notice Claims remain available during oracle outages, exhausted sale budgets and pauses.
 211:     /// Anyone may settle a claim; funds always reach the recorded beneficiary.
 212:     function claim(bytes32 id) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 amount) {
 213:         Note storage n = notes[id];
 214:         amount = claimable(id);
 215:         if (amount == 0) revert NoClaim();
 216:         n.claimed += uint128(amount);
 217:         outstandingClaims -= amount;
 218:         omr.safeTransfer(n.beneficiary, amount);
 219:         emit Claimed(id, n.beneficiary, amount);
 220:     }
 221: 
 222:     function claimable(bytes32 id) public view returns (uint256) {
 223:         Note memory n = notes[id];
 224:         if (n.beneficiary == address(0) || block.timestamp <= n.start) return 0;
 225:         uint256 vested =
 226:             block.timestamp >= n.end ? n.amount : Math.mulDiv(n.amount, block.timestamp - n.start, n.end - n.start);
 227:         return vested - n.claimed;
 228:     }
 229: 
 230:     function claimProceeds() external nonReentrant {
 231:         uint256 amount = proceedsOwed;
 232:         proceedsOwed = 0;
 233:         if (amount != 0) {
 234:             (bool ok,) = proceedsRecipient.call{value: amount}("");
 235:             if (!ok) revert TransferFailed();
 236:         }
 237:         emit ProceedsClaimed(proceedsRecipient, amount);
 238:     }
 239: 
 240:     /// @notice Safe can retire only unpromised inventory. Note collateral is never withdrawable.
 241:     function retireInventory(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
 242:         if (msg.sender != safe) revert Unauthorized();
 243:         if (amount > availableInventory) revert InsufficientInventory();
 244:         availableInventory -= amount;
 245:         omr.safeTransfer(safe, amount);
 246:         emit InventoryRetired(amount);
 247:     }
 248: 
 249:     function _price(uint256 nativeAmount, uint256 omrPerEth) private view returns (uint256) {
 250:         // A D% discount on ETH/OMR price produces OMR/ETH divided by (1-D), rounded down.
 251:         uint256 atMarket = Math.mulDiv(nativeAmount, omrPerEth, 1 ether);
 252:         return Math.mulDiv(atMarket, 10_000, 10_000 - discountBps);
 253:     }
 254: 
 255:     function _observation(uint64 epoch) private view returns (IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory s) {
 256:         s = marketState.snapshot();
 257:         if (
 258:             !s.valid || s.epoch == 0 || s.epoch != epoch || s.observedAt == 0 || s.observedAt > block.timestamp
 259:                 || block.timestamp - s.observedAt > maxObservationAge || s.omrPerEth == 0 || s.omrPerEth > maxOmrPerEth
 260:                 || s.minLiquidity < minLiquidity || manager.getLiquidity(poolId) < minLiquidity
 261:         ) revert InvalidObservation();
 262:         (uint160 spot, int24 tick,,) = manager.getSlot0(poolId);
 263:         int256 difference = int256(tick) - s.meanTick;
 264:         if (difference < 0) difference = -difference;
 265:         if (spot == 0 || uint256(difference) > maxSpotDeviationTicks) revert InvalidObservation();
 266:     }
 267: }

  24: /// @notice Custodies canonical v4 NFTs for a finite term and pays only prefunded depth-time bounties.
  25: /// @dev Scoring is a conservative sampled-depth incentive, NOT proof of continuous tick occupancy.
  26: /// Two distinct fresh observation epochs are required. Gaps, pause transitions, and invalid samples
  27: /// break accrual. Depth is the smaller ETH-valued inventory on each side of a bounded reference band;
  28: /// raw liquidity L, one-sided positions, and a single initial snapshot never earn a reward.
  29: /// Campaign terms are immutable; payment is first-come from available funds at each checkpoint.

 112:         if (terms.startsAt < block.timestamp || terms.endsAt <= terms.startsAt || terms.endsAt - terms.startsAt > 365 days

 137:     function commit(uint256 tokenId, uint64 campaignId, uint32 duration) external nonReentrant {
 138:         if (paused) revert Paused();
 139:         CampaignTerms memory t = _campaigns[campaignId].terms;
 140:         if (block.timestamp < t.startsAt || block.timestamp >= t.endsAt || duration < t.minLock || duration > t.maxLock
 141:             || block.timestamp + duration > t.endsAt) revert InvalidCampaign();
 142:         if (commitments[tokenId].depositor != address(0) || positionManager.ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert InvalidPosition();

 144:         if (PoolId.unwrap(key.toId()) != poolId || info.hasSubscriber() || positionManager.getPositionLiquidity(tokenId) == 0)

 147:         p.depositor = msg.sender;
 148:         p.campaignId = campaignId;
 149:         p.depositedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
 150:         p.maturesAt = uint64(block.timestamp + duration);
 151:         p.generation = pauseGeneration;

 153:         _acceptingFrom = msg.sender;
 154:         positionManager.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tokenId);
 155:         _acceptingFrom = address(0);
 156:         if (positionManager.ownerOf(tokenId) != address(this)) revert InvalidPosition();
 157:         // The first sample initializes an anchor only. It creates no entitlement.
 158:         _checkpoint(tokenId, p);
 159:         emit Committed(tokenId, msg.sender, campaignId, p.maturesAt);
 160:     }

 176:     /// @notice No pause, oracle, campaign budget, owner approval, or fee payment can block maturity exit.
 177:     /// Fees accumulated inside the position remain attached to its original NFT.

 198:     /// @dev Accrual ends at campaign expiry. Grace covers the last valid observation window.
 199:     /// Only funds which never became an entitlement can be recovered, never any NFT.
 200:     function recoverUnusedBudget(uint64 id, address payable recipient) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
 201:         Campaign storage c = _campaigns[id];

 203:             || recipient == address(0) || recipient == address(this)) revert InvalidCampaign();

 205:         c.available = 0;
 206:         availableBudget -= amount;
 207:         (bool ok,) = recipient.call{value: amount}("");
 208:         if (!ok) revert InvalidTransfer();
 209:         emit UnusedBudgetRecovered(id, recipient, amount);
 210:     }

 212:     function usefulDepth(uint256 tokenId, IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory s, uint24 halfWidth)
 213:         public view returns (uint128)
 214:     {
 215:         (, PositionInfo info) = positionManager.getPoolAndPositionInfo(tokenId);
 216:         int256 lower = int256(s.meanTick) - int256(uint256(halfWidth));
 217:         int256 upper = int256(s.meanTick) + int256(uint256(halfWidth));
 218:         // Require the entire reference band and observed volatility margin to fit the position.
 219:         if (lower < TickMath.MIN_TICK || upper > TickMath.MAX_TICK || lower < info.tickLower() || upper > info.tickUpper()
 220:             || s.volatilityTicks > halfWidth || s.omrPerEth == 0) return 0;
 221:         uint128 liquidity = positionManager.getPositionLiquidity(tokenId);
 222:         uint160 mid = TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(s.meanTick);
 223:         uint256 nativeDepth = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(mid, TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(int24(upper)), liquidity, false);
 224:         uint256 omrDepth = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(int24(lower)), mid, liquidity, false);
 225:         uint256 quoteDepth = FullMath.mulDiv(omrDepth, 1 ether, s.omrPerEth);
 226:         uint256 depth = nativeDepth < quoteDepth ? nativeDepth : quoteDepth;
 227:         return depth > type(uint128).max ? type(uint128).max : uint128(depth);
 228:     }
 229: 
 230:     function _checkpoint(uint256 tokenId, Commitment storage p) internal {
 231:         IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory s;
 232:         try marketState.snapshot() returns (IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory result) { s = result; }
 233:         catch { _breakAnchor(tokenId, p); return; }
 234:         if (!s.valid || s.epoch == 0 || s.minLiquidity < minimumMarketLiquidity || s.omrPerEth == 0
 235:             || s.observedAt > block.timestamp || block.timestamp - s.observedAt > maxObservationAge
 236:             || s.observedAt < p.depositedAt) { _breakAnchor(tokenId, p); return; }
 237:         if (s.epoch <= p.lastEpoch || s.observedAt <= p.lastObservedAt) revert InvalidObservation();
 238:         Campaign storage c = _campaigns[p.campaignId];
 239:         uint128 depth = usefulDepth(tokenId, s, c.terms.referenceHalfWidth);
 240:         if (depth > c.terms.maxDepthWei) depth = c.terms.maxDepthWei;
 241:         uint256 depthSeconds;
 242:         uint256 reward;
 243:         if (p.lastObservedAt != 0 && p.generation == pauseGeneration
 244:             && s.observedAt - p.lastObservedAt <= c.terms.maxObservationGap && p.lastObservedAt < p.maturesAt) {
 245:             uint64 until = s.observedAt < p.maturesAt ? s.observedAt : p.maturesAt;
 246:             uint128 minimumDepth = depth < p.lastDepth ? depth : p.lastDepth;
 247:             depthSeconds = uint256(minimumDepth) * (until - p.lastObservedAt);
 248:             p.usefulDepthSeconds += depthSeconds;
 249:             reward = FullMath.mulDiv(depthSeconds, c.terms.rewardWeiPerEthDay, 1 ether * 1 days);
 250:             uint256 remainingCap = c.terms.maxRewardPerPosition - p.rewardCredited;
 251:             if (reward > remainingCap) reward = remainingCap;
 252:             if (reward > c.available) reward = c.available;
 253:             p.rewardCredited += reward;
 254:             c.available -= reward;
 255:             c.paidOrOwed += reward;
 256:             availableBudget -= reward;
 257:             rewardLiability += reward;
 258:             rewards[p.depositor] += reward;
 259:         }
 260:         p.lastEpoch = s.epoch;
 261:         p.lastObservedAt = s.observedAt;
 262:         p.lastDepth = depth;
 263:         p.generation = pauseGeneration;
 264:         emit Checkpointed(tokenId, s.epoch, depthSeconds, reward);
 265:     }
 266: 
 267:     function _breakAnchor(uint256 tokenId, Commitment storage p) internal {
 268:         p.lastObservedAt = 0;
 269:         p.lastDepth = 0;
 270:         p.generation = pauseGeneration;
 271:         emit ObservationSkipped(tokenId);
 272:     }

  20: /// @notice Fixed snapshot player tranche. Off-chain gameplay determines the Merkle list, never this contract.
  21: /// @dev Exact per-wallet settlement avoids aggregate rounding releasing refundable ETH. Anyone may
  22: /// settle another wallet; all participants must settle before migration. No privileged refund override.
  23: contract GenesisPlayerSale is ReentrancyGuard {
  24:     using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  25:     uint256 public constant Q96 = 1 << 96;
  26:     uint256 public constant PURCHASE_WINDOW = 48 hours;

  64:     constructor(IERC20 token_, IGenesisPlayerIntegration integration_, bytes32 root_, uint256 inventory_,
  65:         uint256 openDeadline_, uint256 migrationDeadline_, address unsoldRecipient_) {
  66:         if (address(token_).code.length == 0 || address(integration_).code.length == 0 || root_ == bytes32(0)
  67:             || inventory_ == 0 || openDeadline_ <= block.timestamp
  68:             || migrationDeadline_ <= openDeadline_ + PURCHASE_WINDOW || unsoldRecipient_ == address(0)
  69:             || unsoldRecipient_ == address(this)) revert InvalidConfiguration();
  70:         token = token_; integration = integration_; integrationCodeHash = address(integration_).codehash;
  71:         merkleRoot = root_; chainId = block.chainid; inventory = inventory_;
  72:         openDeadline = openDeadline_; migrationDeadline = migrationDeadline_; unsoldRecipient = unsoldRecipient_;
  73:     }
  74:     function cap(uint8 daysPlayed) public pure returns (uint256) {
  75:         if (daysPlayed == 1) return 0.5 ether;
  76:         if (daysPlayed == 2) return 1 ether;
  77:         if (daysPlayed == 3) return 2.5 ether;
  78:         if (daysPlayed == 4 || daysPlayed == 5) return 5 ether;
  79:         revert InvalidEligibility();
  80:     }
  81:     /// @dev Standard double-hashed Merkle leaf. Predict the CREATE address from the deployer's nonce
  82:     /// before building the root; CREATE2 initcode includes the root and is not a simple prediction.
  83:     function leaf(address wallet, uint8 daysPlayed) public view returns (bytes32) {
  84:         return keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(chainId, address(this), wallet, daysPlayed))));
  85:     }
  86:     function open() external nonReentrant {
  87:         if (cancelled || closesAt != 0 || block.timestamp >= openDeadline
  88:             || block.chainid != chainId || address(integration).codehash != integrationCodeHash
  89:             || token.balanceOf(address(this)) < inventory) revert WrongPhase();
  90:         uint256 price = integration.playerPriceX96();
  91:         if (price == 0 || Math.mulDiv(inventory, price, Q96) == 0) revert InvalidConfiguration();
  92:         priceX96 = price; closesAt = block.timestamp + PURCHASE_WINDOW;
  93:         emit Opened(price, closesAt);
  94:     }
  95:     function contribute(uint8 daysPlayed, bytes32[] calldata proof) external payable nonReentrant {
  96:         if (cancelled || closesAt == 0 || block.timestamp >= closesAt || block.chainid != chainId) revert WrongPhase();
  97:         uint256 maximum = cap(daysPlayed);
  98:         if (msg.value == 0 || requested[msg.sender] + msg.value > maximum
  99:             || !MerkleProof.verifyCalldata(proof, merkleRoot, leaf(msg.sender, daysPlayed))) revert InvalidEligibility();
 100:         if (requested[msg.sender] == 0) participantCount++;
 101:         requested[msg.sender] += msg.value; totalRequested += msg.value;
 102:         emit Contributed(msg.sender, msg.value);
 103:     }
 104:     function settle(address wallet) external {
 105:         if (cancelled || released || closesAt == 0 || block.timestamp < closesAt
 106:             || block.timestamp >= migrationDeadline || requested[wallet] == 0 || settled[wallet]) revert WrongPhase();
 107:         uint256 capacity = Math.mulDiv(inventory, priceX96, Q96);
 108:         uint256 tokens = totalRequested > capacity
 109:             ? Math.mulDiv(requested[wallet], inventory, totalRequested)
 110:             : Math.mulDiv(requested[wallet], Q96, priceX96);
 111:         uint256 payment = Math.mulDiv(tokens, priceX96, Q96, Math.Rounding.Ceil);
 112:         settled[wallet] = true; settledCount++; allocation[wallet] = tokens; accepted[wallet] = payment;
 113:         totalAllocated += tokens; totalAccepted += payment;
 114:         emit Settled(wallet, payment, tokens);
 115:     }
 116:     function releaseProceeds() external nonReentrant {
 117:         if (msg.sender != address(integration) || cancelled || released || closesAt == 0
 118:             || block.timestamp < closesAt || block.timestamp >= migrationDeadline
 119:             || settledCount != participantCount || address(integration).codehash != integrationCodeHash
 120:             || block.chainid != chainId) revert WrongPhase();
 121:         released = true;
 122:         integration.finalizePlayerProceeds{value: totalAccepted}();
 123:         if (!integration.playerMigrationSucceeded()) revert WrongPhase();
 124:         emit ProceedsReleased(totalAccepted);
 125:     }
 126:     function cancel() external {
 127:         if (released || cancelled || block.timestamp < migrationDeadline) revert WrongPhase();
 128:         cancelled = true; emit Cancelled();
 129:     }
 130:     function refund() external nonReentrant {
 131:         if ((!cancelled && !released) || refunded[msg.sender] || requested[msg.sender] == 0) revert WrongPhase();
 132:         refunded[msg.sender] = true;
 133:         uint256 amount = requested[msg.sender] - (cancelled ? 0 : accepted[msg.sender]);
 134:         (bool ok,) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");
 135:         if (!ok) revert TransferFailed();
 136:         emit Refunded(msg.sender, amount);
 137:     }
 138:     function claim() external nonReentrant {
 139:         if (!released || cancelled || claimed[msg.sender] || allocation[msg.sender] == 0
 140:             || block.chainid != chainId || address(integration).codehash != integrationCodeHash
 141:             || !integration.playerClaimsOpen()) revert WrongPhase();
 142:         claimed[msg.sender] = true; token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, allocation[msg.sender]);
 143:         emit Claimed(msg.sender, allocation[msg.sender]);
 144:     }
 145:     function recoverUnsold() external nonReentrant {
 146:         if ((!released && !cancelled) || unsoldRecovered) revert WrongPhase();
 147:         unsoldRecovered = true; token.safeTransfer(unsoldRecipient, inventory - (cancelled ? 0 : totalAllocated));
 148:     }

 217:     function depositFees(uint64 seasonId, uint32 turfId, uint256 omrAmount) external payable nonReentrant {
 218:         FeeLane memory lane = feeSources[msg.sender];

 238:             return;
 239:         }

 241:         if (escrowed) { s.nativeEscrow += msg.value; s.omrEscrow += omrAmount; }
 242:         else _credit(_recipients(_turfs[seasonId][turfId].owners), msg.value, omrAmount);

 261:     function _settlement(uint64 seasonId, uint32 turfId, uint64 revision, uint64 epoch, bytes32 id)
 262:         internal returns (Turf storage t)
 263:     {
 264:         if (msg.sender != game) revert Unauthorized();
 265:         Season storage s = seasons[seasonId];
 266:         if (block.timestamp < s.startsAt || block.timestamp >= s.endsAt || turfId >= s.turfCount) revert InvalidSeason();
 267:         t = _turfs[seasonId][turfId];
 268:         if (t.revision != revision) revert StaleRevision();
 269:         bytes32 replayKey = keccak256(abi.encode(block.chainid, address(this), seasonId, turfId, id));
 270:         if (id == bytes32(0) || settlementUsed[replayKey]) revert InvalidSettlement();
 271:         IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory observation = marketState.snapshot();
 272:         if (!observation.valid || epoch != observation.epoch || epoch < t.lastEpoch
 273:             || observation.observedAt > block.timestamp || block.timestamp - observation.observedAt > maxObservationAge)
 274:             revert InvalidSettlement();
 275:         settlementUsed[replayKey] = true;
 276:         t.lastEpoch = epoch;
 277:         ++t.revision;
 278:     }

 280:     function _recipients(Split memory split) internal view returns (Recipients memory r) {
 281:         if (split.count == 0 || split.count > 4) revert InvalidConfiguration();
 282:         uint256 total;
 283:         r.count = split.count;
 284:         for (uint256 i; i < 4; ++i) {
 285:             if (i >= split.count) {
 286:                 if (split.families[i] != 0 || split.shares[i] != 0) revert InvalidConfiguration();
 287:                 continue;
 288:             }
 289:             if (split.shares[i] == 0 || familyTreasury[split.families[i]] == address(0)) revert InvalidConfiguration();
 290:             for (uint256 j; j < i; ++j) if (split.families[j] == split.families[i]) revert InvalidConfiguration();
 291:             r.wallets[i] = familyTreasury[split.families[i]];
 292:             r.shares[i] = split.shares[i];
 293:             total += split.shares[i];
 294:         }
 295:         if (total != BPS) revert InvalidConfiguration();
 296:     }
 297: 
 298:     function _credit(Recipients memory r, uint256 nativeAmount, uint256 omrAmount) internal {
 299:         uint256 nativeLeft = nativeAmount;
 300:         uint256 omrLeft = omrAmount;
 301:         for (uint256 i; i < r.count; ++i) {
 302:             uint256 n = i + 1 == r.count ? nativeLeft : nativeAmount * r.shares[i] / BPS;
 303:             uint256 o = i + 1 == r.count ? omrLeft : omrAmount * r.shares[i] / BPS;
 304:             nativeLeft -= n;
 305:             omrLeft -= o;
 306:             credits[r.wallets[i]].nativeAmount += n;
 307:             credits[r.wallets[i]].omrAmount += o;
 308:         }
 309:     }
 310: 
 311:     function _finishSiege(uint64 seasonId, uint32 turfId, bool attackerWon, bool expired) internal {
 312:         Siege memory s = _sieges[seasonId][turfId];
 313:         delete _sieges[seasonId][turfId];
 314:         uint256 attackerNative = attackerWon ? s.nativeEscrow * s.attackerVictoryBps / BPS : 0;
 315:         uint256 attackerOmr = attackerWon ? s.omrEscrow * s.attackerVictoryBps / BPS : 0;
 316:         _credit(s.defenderRecipients, s.nativeEscrow - attackerNative, s.omrEscrow - attackerOmr);
 317:         if (attackerWon) {
 318:             _credit(s.attackerRecipients, attackerNative, attackerOmr);
 319:             Turf storage t = _turfs[seasonId][turfId];
 320:             t.owners = s.attacker;
 321:             t.corridors = 0;
 322:             t.loyaltyBps = 0;
 323:             t.fortification = 0;
 324:         }
 325:         emit SiegeEnded(seasonId, turfId, attackerWon, expired);
 326:     }
 327: 
 328:     function _connected(Turf storage a, Turf storage b, bool right) internal view returns (bool) {
 329:         return (right ? a.upperTick == b.lowerTick : a.lowerTick == b.upperTick)
 330:             && keccak256(abi.encode(a.owners)) == keccak256(abi.encode(b.owners));
 331:     }
 332: }

   8: /// @notice Typed game settlement boundary: earned fees settle before future rights change.
   9: /// @dev The adjudicator decides game outcomes. It cannot withdraw principal or create unbacked fees.
  10: contract OmertaGameSettlementV2 is ReentrancyGuard {

  12:     address public immutable safe;

  23:     constructor(address safe_, address adjudicator_) {
  24:         if (safe_ == address(0) || adjudicator_ == address(0)) revert InvalidBinding();
  25:         safe = safe_;

  29:         if (msg.sender != adjudicator) revert Unauthorized();

  37:                 || registry_.owner() != safe

  43:     function registerLane(OmertaTurfFeeBridgeV2 bridge) external {
  44:         if (msg.sender != safe) revert Unauthorized();
  45:         if (
  46:             address(registry) == address(0) || address(bridge).code.length == 0
  47:                 || address(bridge.registry()) != address(registry) || bridge.safe() != safe
  48:                 || address(bridge.source()) == address(0) || bridge.closed() || _active.length >= MAX_ACTIVE_LANES
  49:         ) revert InvalidBinding();
  50:         uint64 season = bridge.seasonId();
  51:         uint32 turf = bridge.turfId();
  52:         (uint64 startsAt,,) = registry.seasons(season);
  53:         if (block.timestamp >= startsAt) revert InvalidBinding();
  54:         (uint64 laneSeason, uint32 laneTurf, bool bound) = registry.feeSources(address(bridge));
  55:         if (!bound || laneSeason != season || laneTurf != turf || address(bridges[season][turf]) != address(0)) {
  56:             revert InvalidBinding();
  57:         }
  58:         bridges[season][turf] = bridge;
  59:         _active.push(bridge);
  60:         emit LaneRegistered(season, turf, address(bridge));
  61:     }
  62: 
  63:     function activeLanes() external view returns (OmertaTurfFeeBridgeV2[] memory) {

  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     /// @dev Free capacity for later seasons only after all source fees have reached their recipients.
  68:     function archiveLane(uint256 index) external nonReentrant {
  69:         if (index >= _active.length) revert InvalidBinding();
  70:         OmertaTurfFeeBridgeV2 bridge = _active[index];
  71:         bridge.close();
  72:         _active[index] = _active[_active.length - 1];
  73:         _active.pop();
  74:         emit LaneArchived(address(bridge));
  75:     }

  84:         for (uint256 i; i < _active.length; ++i) {

 136:     }

 138:     /// @notice Permissionless expiry still checkpoints the frozen fee recipients atomically.
 139:     function expireSiege(uint64 season, uint32 turf) external nonReentrant {
 140:         OmertaTurfV2.Siege memory siege = registry.siege(season, turf);
 141:         if (siege.expiresAt == 0 || block.timestamp < siege.expiresAt) revert InvalidBinding();
 142:         _checkpoint(season, turf);

 148:         if (address(bridge) == address(0)) revert InvalidBinding();

  10: /// @notice One immutable seasonal range's earned LP fees, checkpointed before game ownership changes.
  11: /// @dev Source counters distinguish earned fees from donated balances. Principal never crosses this bridge.
  12: contract OmertaTurfFeeBridgeV2 is ReentrancyGuard {
  13:     using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  14:     uint256 private constant TURF = 6;
  15:     address public immutable safe;
  16:     OmertaTurfV2 public immutable registry;
  17:     IERC20 public immutable omr;
  18:     uint64 public immutable seasonId;
  19:     uint32 public immutable turfId;
  20:     OmertaStabilityControllerV2 public source;
  21:     uint256 public forwardedNative;
  22:     uint256 public forwardedOmr;
  23:     bool public closed;
  24: 
  25:     error Unauthorized();
  26:     error InvalidBinding();
  27:     error InvalidAccounting();
  28:     error NotExpired();
  29:     event SourceBound(address indexed controller);
  30:     event FeesForwarded(uint256 nativeAmount, uint256 omrAmount);
  31:     event Closed();
  32: 
  33:     constructor(address safe_, OmertaTurfV2 registry_, uint64 season_, uint32 turf_) {
  34:         if (safe_ == address(0) || address(registry_).code.length == 0 || registry_.owner() != safe_) {
  35:             revert InvalidBinding();
  36:         }
  37:         (uint64 startsAt, uint64 endsAt, uint32 count) = registry_.seasons(season_);
  38:         if (startsAt == 0 || endsAt <= startsAt || turf_ >= count) revert InvalidBinding();
  39:         safe = safe_;
  40:         registry = registry_;
  41:         omr = registry_.omr();
  42:         seasonId = season_;
  43:         turfId = turf_;
  44:     }
  45: 
  46:     /// @dev One-time binding permits deployment before its controller names this fee recipient.
  47:     function bindSource(OmertaStabilityControllerV2 controller) external {
  48:         if (msg.sender != safe) revert Unauthorized();
  49:         if (address(source) != address(0) || address(controller).code.length == 0) revert InvalidBinding();
  50:         OmertaTurfV2.Turf memory t = registry.turf(seasonId, turfId);
  51:         (uint64 startsAt, uint64 endsAt,) = registry.seasons(seasonId);
  52:         if (
  53:             controller.safe() != safe || controller.feeRecipients(TURF) != address(this)
  54:                 || address(controller.omr()) != address(omr)
  55:                 || address(controller.marketState()) != address(registry.marketState())
  56:                 || controller.poolKey().tickSpacing != registry.tickSpacing() || controller.turfLower() != t.lowerTick
  57:                 || controller.turfUpper() != t.upperTick || controller.turfSeasonStart() != startsAt
  58:                 || controller.turfSeasonEnd() != endsAt
  59:         ) {
  60:             revert InvalidBinding();
  61:         }
  62:         source = controller;
  63:         emit SourceBound(address(controller));
  64:     }
  65: 
  66:     receive() external payable {
  67:         if (msg.sender != address(source)) revert Unauthorized();
  68:     }
  69: 
  70:     function checkpointFees() external nonReentrant {
  71:         _checkpoint();
  72:     }
  73: 
  74:     /// @notice Close only after the source range can no longer be deployed or accrue new fees.
  75:     function close() external nonReentrant {
  76:         (, uint64 endsAt,) = registry.seasons(seasonId);
  77:         if (block.timestamp < endsAt) revert NotExpired();
  78:         _checkpoint();
  79:         closed = true;
  80:         emit Closed();
  81:     }
  82: 
  83:     function _checkpoint() private {
  84:         if (closed) return;
  85:         if (address(source) == address(0)) revert InvalidBinding();
  86:         (uint64 laneSeason, uint32 laneTurf, bool bound) = registry.feeSources(address(this));
  87:         if (!bound || laneSeason != seasonId || laneTurf != turfId) revert InvalidBinding();
  88:         OmertaStabilityControllerV2.Tranche tranche = OmertaStabilityControllerV2.Tranche.Turf;
  89:         OmertaStabilityControllerV2.Position memory p = source.position(tranche);
  90:         if (p.liquidity != 0) {
  91:             if (block.timestamp >= source.turfSeasonEnd()) source.expireTurf();
  92:             else source.collect(tranche);
  93:         }
  94:         OmertaStabilityControllerV2.Account memory a = source.account(tranche);
  95:         if (a.nativeFees != 0 || a.omrFees != 0) source.claimFees(tranche);
  96:         uint256 nativeTotal = source.claimedNativeFees(TURF);
  97:         uint256 omrTotal = source.claimedOmrFees(TURF);
  98:         if (nativeTotal < forwardedNative || omrTotal < forwardedOmr) revert InvalidAccounting();
  99:         uint256 nativeAmount = nativeTotal - forwardedNative;
 100:         uint256 omrAmount = omrTotal - forwardedOmr;
 101:         if (nativeAmount > address(this).balance || omrAmount > omr.balanceOf(address(this))) {
 102:             revert InvalidAccounting();
 103:         }
 104:         if (nativeAmount == 0 && omrAmount == 0) return;
 105:         forwardedNative = nativeTotal;
 106:         forwardedOmr = omrTotal;
 107:         if (omrAmount != 0) omr.forceApprove(address(registry), omrAmount);
 108:         registry.depositFees{value: nativeAmount}(seasonId, turfId, omrAmount);
 109:         if (omrAmount != 0) omr.forceApprove(address(registry), 0);
 110:         emit FeesForwarded(nativeAmount, omrAmount);
 111:     }

 368:     /// @notice Records at most one fresh observation per spaced interval, never repeated epochs.
 369:     /// Recovery requires the entire Y-sample window to have been observed, and X healthy samples.
 370:     function observeRecovery(Tranche t, uint64 expectedEpoch) external nonReentrant {

 459:     function _observation(uint64 epoch) private view returns (IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory s) {

 474:     function _updateRegime(IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory s) private {
 475:         if (s.epoch < lastRegimeEpoch || s.observedAt < lastRegimeAt) revert InvalidObservation();

 480:         if (next != stressed) {

 486:     function _range(Tranche t, IOmertaMarketStateV2.Snapshot memory s) private view returns (int24 lower, int24 upper) {

 490:         if (s.meanTick < 0 && int256(s.meanTick) % spacing != 0) --anchor;
 491:         anchor *= spacing;
 492:         uint256 width = uint256(s.volatilityTicks) * 2;
 493:         width = width < minBandTicks ? minBandTicks : (width > maxBandTicks ? maxBandTicks : width);
 494:         int256 step = int256((width + uint256(spacing) - 1) / uint256(spacing)) * spacing;
 495:         int256 lo;
 496:         int256 hi;
 497:         if (t == Tranche.LowerCushion) {
 498:             lo = anchor + step;
 499:             hi = anchor + step * 2;
 500:         } else if (t == Tranche.Garrison) {
 501:             lo = anchor + step * 2;
 502:             hi = anchor + step * 3;
 503:         } else if (t == Tranche.UpperCushion) {
 504:             lo = anchor - step * 2;
 505:             hi = anchor - step;
 506:         } else if (t == Tranche.Desk) {
 507:             lo = anchor - step * 3;
 508:             hi = anchor - step * 2;
 509:         } else if (t == Tranche.Core) {
 510:             lo = anchor - step * 4;
 511:             hi = anchor + step * 4;
 512:         } else {
 513:             lo = anchor - step;
 514:             hi = anchor + step;
 515:         }
 516:         if (lo < TickMath.MIN_TICK || hi > TickMath.MAX_TICK || lo >= hi) revert InvalidObservation();
 517:         return (int24(lo), int24(hi));
 518:     }
 519: 
 520:     function _modify(Tranche t, Operation op, uint128 liquidity, uint256 budget0, uint256 budget1) private {
 521:         bytes memory data = abi.encode(t, op, liquidity, budget0, budget1);
 522:         _callbackHash = keccak256(data);
 523:         manager.unlock(data);
 524:         if (_callbackHash != bytes32(0)) revert BadCallback();
 525:     }
 526: 
 527:     function unlockCallback(bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes memory) {
 528:         if (msg.sender != address(manager) || _callbackHash == bytes32(0) || keccak256(data) != _callbackHash) {
 529:             revert BadCallback();
 530:         }
 531:         _callbackHash = bytes32(0);
 532:         (Tranche t, Operation op, uint128 liquidity, uint256 budget0, uint256 budget1) =
 533:             abi.decode(data, (Tranche, Operation, uint128, uint256, uint256));
 534:         Position storage p = _positions[uint256(t)];
 535:         int256 change = op == Operation.Add
 536:             ? int256(uint256(liquidity))
 537:             : op == Operation.Exit ? -int256(uint256(liquidity)) : int256(0);
 538:         (BalanceDelta delta, BalanceDelta fees) = manager.modifyLiquidity(
 539:             _key, ModifyLiquidityParams(p.lower, p.upper, change, keccak256(abi.encode(t, p.nonce))), ""
 540:         );
 541:         int256 principal0 = int256(delta.amount0()) - fees.amount0();
 542:         int256 principal1 = int256(delta.amount1()) - fees.amount1();
 543:         if (fees.amount0() < 0 || fees.amount1() < 0) revert BadSettlement();
 544:         Account storage a = _accounts[uint256(t)];
 545:         if (op == Operation.Add) {
 546:             if (principal0 > 0 || principal1 > 0 || uint256(-principal0) > budget0 || uint256(-principal1) > budget1) {
 547:                 revert BadSettlement();
 548:             }
 549:             uint256 amount0 = uint256(-principal0);
 550:             uint256 amount1 = uint256(-principal1);
 551:             a.idleNative -= amount0;
 552:             a.idleOmr -= amount1;
 553:             totalIdleNative -= amount0;
 554:             totalIdleOmr -= amount1;
 555:             a.nativeCapacity -= uint128(amount0);
 556:             a.omrCapacity -= uint128(amount1);
 557:             a.nativeDeployed += amount0;
 558:             a.omrDeployed += amount1;
 559:             emit PrincipalMoved(t, true, amount0, amount1);
 560:         } else {
 561:             if (principal0 < 0 || principal1 < 0 || (op == Operation.Collect && (principal0 != 0 || principal1 != 0))) {
 562:                 revert BadSettlement();
 563:             }
 564:             a.idleNative += uint256(principal0);
 565:             a.idleOmr += uint256(principal1);
 566:             totalIdleNative += uint256(principal0);
 567:             totalIdleOmr += uint256(principal1);
 568:             a.nativeReturned += uint256(principal0);
 569:             a.omrReturned += uint256(principal1);
 570:             if (op == Operation.Exit) emit PrincipalMoved(t, false, uint256(principal0), uint256(principal1));
 571:         }
 572:         uint256 fee0 = uint256(uint128(fees.amount0()));
 573:         uint256 fee1 = uint256(uint128(fees.amount1()));
 574:         a.nativeFees += fee0;
 575:         a.omrFees += fee1;
 576:         totalNativeFees += fee0;
 577:         totalOmrFees += fee1;
 578:         if (fee0 != 0 || fee1 != 0) emit FeesCollected(t, fee0, fee1);
 579:         _settle(_key.currency0, delta.amount0());
 580:         _settle(_key.currency1, delta.amount1());
 581:         return "";
 582:     }
 583: 
 584:     function _settle(Currency currency, int128 delta) private {
 585:         if (delta > 0) {
 586:             manager.take(currency, address(this), uint256(uint128(delta)));
 587:         } else if (delta < 0) {
 588:             uint256 amount = uint256(-int256(delta));
 589:             if (Currency.unwrap(currency) == address(0)) {
 590:                 // A previous ERC20 sync can persist through the unlock. Explicitly select ETH.
 591:                 manager.sync(currency);
 592:                 if (manager.settle{value: amount}() != amount) revert BadSettlement();
 593:             } else {
 594:                 manager.sync(currency);
 595:                 omr.safeTransfer(address(manager), amount);
 596:                 if (manager.settle() != amount) revert BadSettlement();
 597:             }
 598:         }
 599:     }

 601:     function _send(address to, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) private {
 602:         if (amount0 != 0) {
 603:             (bool ok,) = to.call{value: amount0}("");
 604:             if (!ok) revert TransferFailed();
 605:         }
 606:         if (amount1 != 0) omr.safeTransfer(to, amount1);
 607:     }

 610:         return t == Tranche.LowerCushion || t == Tranche.Garrison;
 611:     }
 612: 
 613:     function _upside(Tranche t) private pure returns (bool) {
 614:         return t == Tranche.UpperCushion || t == Tranche.Desk;
 615:     }

 622:         while (n != 0) {
 623:             n &= n - 1;
 624:             ++count;
 625:         }

 204:     /// @notice Set the harvest performance fee and its recipient. Bounded by `MAX_HARVEST_FEE_BPS`,
 205:     ///         which a stolen key cannot raise. Setting the recipient to zero turns the fee OFF.
 206:     function setHarvestFee(uint16 bps, address recipient) external onlyOwner {
 207:         if (bps > MAX_HARVEST_FEE_BPS) revert FeeTooHigh();
 208:         // Two addresses swallow the fee without anyone noticing, which is why they are named rather
 209:         // than left to care: THIS contract has no rescue path, so a sweep to itself would zero
 210:         // `accruedFees` against a transfer that moved nothing; and the Transmuter tracks reserves in
 211:         // a VARIABLE, never a balance, so assets sent there neither back a redemption nor come back
 212:         // out. `address(0)` is the deliberate off switch and stays allowed. The point of a
 213:         // fail-safe is that it is complete - a half-covered one reads as covered.
 214:         if (recipient == address(this) || recipient == address(transmuter)) revert BadFeeRecipient();
 215:         _assertLtvFeeCompatible(ltvBps, bps);
 216:         harvestFeeBps = bps;
 217:         feeRecipient = recipient;
 218:         emit HarvestFeeSet(bps, recipient);
 219:     }

 262:     /// @notice Deposit collateral with a caller-chosen ERC-4626 share floor.
 263:     /// @dev    The floor is mandatory because a vault donation can move its exchange rate between
 264:     ///         quote construction and execution. Measuring the escrow's actual share-balance delta
 265:     ///         also prevents a vault from satisfying this check with a dishonest return value.
 266:     function deposit(uint256 assets, uint256 minSharesOut) external nonReentrant onlyAllowedCaller {
 267:         if (assets == 0 || minSharesOut == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
 268:         CollateralEscrow e = escrowOf[msg.sender];
 269:         if (address(e) == address(0)) {
 270:             e = new CollateralEscrow(msg.sender, asset, vault);
 271:             escrowOf[msg.sender] = e;
 272:             emit EscrowCreated(msg.sender, address(e));
 273:         }
 274:         // FlashGuard L1: this stamps the block, so a borrow or withdrawal in the SAME transaction
 275:         // reverts. That is what makes the atomic depositborrowexit round trip impossible.
 276:         _recordEntry(msg.sender);
 277: 
 278:         uint256 assetBalanceBefore = asset.balanceOf(address(e));
 279:         asset.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(e), assets);
 280:         uint256 assetBalanceAfter = asset.balanceOf(address(e));
 281:         if (assetBalanceAfter < assetBalanceBefore) revert AssetTransferMismatch(0, assets);
 282:         uint256 received = assetBalanceAfter - assetBalanceBefore;
 283:         if (received != assets) revert AssetTransferMismatch(received, assets);
 284: 
 285:         uint256 shares = e.deployToVault(assets);
 286:         if (shares < minSharesOut) revert InsufficientShares(shares, minSharesOut);
 287:         principalOf[msg.sender] += assets;
 288:         emit Deposited(msg.sender, assets);
 289:     }

 291:     function withdraw(uint256 assets) external nonReentrant onlyAllowedCaller notSameBlockAsEntry(msg.sender) {
 292:         if (assets == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
 293:         CollateralEscrow e = escrowOf[msg.sender];
 294:         if (address(e) == address(0)) revert NoEscrow();
 295: 
 296:         e.withdraw(assets, msg.sender);
 297:         // principal is a floor-tracked figure: withdrawing more than principal means the excess
 298:         // came from yield, and principal simply bottoms out at zero.
 299:         uint256 p = principalOf[msg.sender];
 300:         principalOf[msg.sender] = assets >= p ? 0 : p - assets;
 301: 
 302:         // the invariant, checked AFTER the move
 303:         if (debtOf[msg.sender] > maxDebtOf(msg.sender)) revert Undercollateralised();
 304:         emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, assets);
 305:     }

 309:     /// @notice Draw `debtAmount` of DNR (18dp) against your escrow.
 310:     function mint(uint256 debtAmount) external nonReentrant onlyAllowedCaller notSameBlockAsEntry(msg.sender) {
 311:         if (debtAmount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
 312:         if (address(escrowOf[msg.sender]) == address(0)) revert NoEscrow();
 313:         // 2.4's ordering: the protocol stops ISSUING before it stops paying. A thin buffer halts
 314:         // new debt here; it never touches the Transmuter's ability to honour existing claims.
 315:         if (!transmuter.bufferHealthy()) revert BufferUnhealthy();
 316: 
 317:         _meter(_mintFlow, debtAmount, mintPerBlockCap, mintPerDayCap);
 318: 
 319:         uint256 newDebt = debtOf[msg.sender] + debtAmount;
 320:         if (newDebt > maxDebtOf(msg.sender)) revert Undercollateralised();
 321:         debtOf[msg.sender] = newDebt;
 322: 
 323:         debtToken.mint(msg.sender, debtAmount);
 324:         // `bufferHealthy` depends on total DNR supply. The pre-check above protects an already-thin
 325:         // reserve; this post-state check prevents the issuance itself from crossing the floor.
 326:         // Reverting here atomically rolls back both the token mint and the debt write.
 327:         if (!transmuter.bufferHealthy()) revert BufferUnhealthy();
 328:         emit Minted(msg.sender, debtAmount);
 329:     }

 332: 
 333:     /// @notice Repay in UNDERLYING. The assets go to the Transmuter as backing.
 334:     /// @dev    Repayment is deliberately not "burn your DNR here": the Transmuter is the single
 335:     ///         burn authority (Denari's header), and paying in underlying is strictly better for the
 336:     ///         system - it clears debt AND deepens the buffer, leaving the outstanding DNR fully
 337:     ///         redeemable rather than merely destroyed. Anyone holding DNR who wants out uses the
 338:     ///         Transmuter directly.
 339:     ///
 340:     ///         Overpayment is REFUSED rather than banked as a credit. A negative debt balance is a
 341:     ///         claim on the protocol, and this batch issues none. Clamping at zero prevents a user
 342:     ///         acquiring repayment credit beyond the debt actually cleared.
 343:     function repay(uint256 assets) external nonReentrant {
 344:         if (assets == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
 345:         uint256 d = debtOf[msg.sender];
 346:         if (d == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
 347: 
 348:         uint256 asDebt = assets * scale;
 349:         if (asDebt > d) {
 350:             asDebt = d;
 351:             assets = (d + scale - 1) / scale; // round UP so the protocol is never short-changed
 352:         }
 353: 
 354:         asset.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);
 355:         debtOf[msg.sender] = d - asDebt;
 356: 
 357:         asset.forceApprove(address(transmuter), assets);
 358:         transmuter.fund(assets);
 359:         asset.forceApprove(address(transmuter), 0);
 360: 
 361:         emit Repaid(msg.sender, assets, asDebt);
 362:     }

 364:     // �� harvest: the self-repaying half ����������������������������������������������������������
 365: 
 366:     /// @notice Realise the yield a user's escrow has earned above principal and apply it to debt.
 367:     /// @dev    Permissionless by design - anyone may harvest anyone. It can only ever REDUCE the
 368:     ///         target's debt and move their yield into backing, so there is nothing for a caller to
 369:     ///         extract and no reason to gate it. That also means a keeper can run it, which is what
 370:     ///         makes the loan self-repaying without the user doing anything.
 371:     function harvest(address user) external nonReentrant {
 372:         CollateralEscrow e = escrowOf[user];
 373:         if (address(e) == address(0)) revert NoEscrow();
 374: 
 375:         uint256 total = e.totalAssets();
 376:         uint256 p = principalOf[user];
 377:         if (total <= p) revert NothingToHarvest();
 378:         uint256 yield_ = total - p;
 379: 
 380:         uint256 d = debtOf[user];
 381:         if (d == 0) revert NothingToHarvest(); // leave the yield compounding in the escrow
 382: 
 383:         // THE PERFORMANCE FEE comes off the yield BEFORE it services debt, so `net` is what this
 384:         // harvest can actually repay. A zero recipient disables it (fail-safe: an unset recipient
 385:         // under-charges rather than burning the yield).
 386:         uint16 feeBps = feeRecipient == address(0) ? 0 : harvestFeeBps;
 387:         uint256 net = yield_ - (yield_ * feeBps) / BPS;
 388: 
 389:         // Take the whole (net) yield unless it would clear more than is owed, in which case take
 390:         // only what the debt needs - rounded UP, so the assets moved always cover the debt cleared
 391:         // and never the other way round.
 392:         uint256 take = net;
 393:         uint256 asDebt = take * scale;
 394:         if (asDebt > d) {
 395:             take = (d + scale - 1) / scale; // ceil(d / scale)
 396:             if (take > net) take = net;
 397:             asDebt = take * scale;
 398:             if (asDebt > d) asDebt = d;
 399:         }
 400: 
 401:         // The fee is PROPORTIONAL TO WHAT WAS TAKEN, not to the escrow balance: fee / (take + fee)
 402:         // == feeBps / BPS. When the debt is smaller than the yield, the untouched remainder keeps
 403:         // compounding for the user and is never billed - which is what stops this becoming a
 404:         // management fee that charges for the same money every harvest.
 405:         //   In exact arithmetic both branches satisfy `take + fee <= yield_`:
 406:         //     debt-bound   take = need <= net = yield_(1-f)  =>  take + fee = need/(1-f) <= yield_
 407:         //     yield-bound  take = net  = yield_(1-f)         =>  take + fee = yield_ exactly
 408:         //
 409:         // THE CLAMP BELOW IS REACHABLE, and the argument above is why it is easy to believe it is
 410:         // not. `net` is computed with a floored fee, so net >= yield_(1-f) - it can sit up to one
 411:         // unit ABOVE the exact figure, and dividing that back out by (1-f) can overshoot yield_ by
 412:         // up to 1/(1-f). At DUST scale that rounds into a whole unit: yield_ = 4, f = 20% gives
 413:         // net = 4, take = 4, naive fee = 1, take + fee = 5 > 4. Without the clamp the escrow would
 414:         // be asked for more than it realised. It fires only in the last unit or two, which is
 415:         // exactly why no test above the micro-unit range can see it - the fuzz's lower bound is
 416:         // now 1 wei so it can, and test_the_dust_clamp_is_reachable pins the case by hand.
 417:         uint256 fee = feeBps == 0 ? 0 : (take * feeBps) / (BPS - feeBps);
 418:         if (take + fee > yield_) fee = yield_ - take;
 419: 
 420:         e.withdraw(take + fee, address(this));
 421:         debtOf[user] = d - asDebt;
 422: 
 423:         // Fee-bearing/nonlinear ERC-4626 vaults can consume more share value than the requested
 424:         // underlying transfer suggests. Value collateral from redeemable assets (in the escrow)
 425:         // and re-assert the position invariant after the shares have actually been burned.
 426:         if (debtOf[user] > maxDebtOf(user)) revert Undercollateralised();
 427: 
 428:         // THE FEE ACCRUES; `sweepFees` pushes it. Do NOT "simplify" this into an in-tx transfer to
 429:         // `feeRecipient`. `harvest` is the self-repaying mechanism and it is PERMISSIONLESS - a
 430:         // keeper runs it for everyone - so a recipient that cannot receive would brick it for every
 431:         // borrower in the market, not just for the treasury. That is not hypothetical on a USDC
 432:         // market: USDC has a live blocklist, and a blocked recipient would turn a revenue setting
 433:         // into a protocol outage. The rule is the one `OmertaHook` already follows for exactly this
 434:         // reason (subtree CLAUDE.md rule 7): pool/mechanism liveness must never depend on a wallet's
 435:         // behaviour. A broken recipient now costs a failed sweep, which the Safe can fix.
 436:         if (fee > 0) {
 437:             accruedFees += fee;
 438:             emit HarvestFeeTaken(user, feeRecipient, fee);
 439:         }
 440: 
 441:         asset.forceApprove(address(transmuter), take);
 442:         transmuter.fund(take);
 443:         asset.forceApprove(address(transmuter), 0);
 444: 
 445:         emit Harvested(user, take, asDebt);
 446:     }
 447: }

  13: /// @title Transmuter - 1:1 redemption, the buffer floor, and the only burn authority
  14: /// @notice Design: `omerta-bank-protocol-design.md` 2.4, answering Runtime Verification's finding
  15: ///         #2 against Alchemix (the 1:1 promise must survive the backing losing value).
  16: ///
  17: ///         �� THE PROMISE, AND THE FOUR THINGS THAT KEEP IT ������������������������������������
  18: ///         One DNR redeems for one dollar of underlying. Always, or the peg is a suggestion.
  19: ///           1. **Denomination matching** (2.1) removes the price leg of RV's risk before it
  20: ///              starts - the collateral behind this token is the same unit as the debt.
  21: ///           2. **A hard buffer floor.** `bufferHealthy()` is false when reserves fall below
  22: ///              `BUFFER_FLOOR_BPS` of outstanding supply, and the Alchemist refuses to ISSUE while
  23: ///              it is false. **The protocol stops issuing before it stops paying** - that ordering
  24: ///              is the whole point and it is why the floor gates minting, not redemption.
  25: ///           3. **Flow limits** so one block cannot drain the queue.
  26: ///           4. Per-position debt-vs-collateral checks in the Alchemist and conservation of DNR
  27: ///              against debt plus funded reserves, assuming the configured authorities and assets.
  28: ///
  29: ///         �� WHY REDEMPTION IS NOT SAME-BLOCK GUARDED, DELIBERATELY ���������������������������
  30: ///         `FlashGuard`'s L1 is absent from `redeem()` ON PURPOSE. Somebody who flash-loans to buy
  31: ///         DNR at 0.98 and redeems it here at 1.00 is REPAIRING OUR PEG at their own gas risk.
  32: ///         Blanket-blocking atomicity would disable the mechanism that keeps the peg honest - the
  33: ///         guards attach where atomicity creates an advantage, never where it creates a service.
  34: ///
  35: ///         Flow caps still apply, and they are a different tool: a cap bounds the SIZE of a drain
  36: ///         without forbidding the arbitrage. Do not "harden" this by adding `notSameBlockAsEntry`
  37: ///         to `redeem` - that would trade a live peg defense for a guard against nothing.
  38: ///
  39: ///         �� ACCOUNTING �����������������������������������������������������������������������
  40: ///         Reserves are tracked in a VARIABLE, never `asset.balanceOf(this)` (FlashGuard L7). A
  41: ///         direct token transfer to this contract is therefore ignored rather than credited, so a
  42: ///         donation cannot move the redemption rate or fake buffer health. Someone who wants to
  43: ///         strengthen the buffer calls `fund()`.
  44: ///

  57: ///         window in which the protocol issues claims it cannot honour, which is the exact

  59: contract Transmuter is Ownable2Step, ReentrancyGuard, FlashGuard {
  60:     using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  61: 
  62:     /// @notice Compile-time floor on the buffer floor. The Safe may set the floor ANYWHERE AT OR
  63:     ///         ABOVE this; it can never configure the protocol to back claims more thinly than
  64:     ///         this, even with a stolen key. The OmertaBond `MAX_DISCOUNT_BPS` discipline.
  65:     uint16 public constant MIN_BUFFER_FLOOR_BPS = 500; // 5%
  66:     uint16 public constant BPS = 10_000;
  67: 
  68:     Denari public immutable debtToken;
  69:     IERC20 public immutable asset;
  70:     /// @dev 10^(18 - assetDecimals). DNR is 18dp; USDC is 6dp. A 1:1 redemption across a decimal
  71:     ///      mismatch is a classic silent-loss bug, so the scale is computed once at construction
  72:     ///      from the token itself rather than passed in and trusted.
  73:     uint256 public immutable scale;
  74: 
  75:     /// @notice Underlying held to honour redemptions, in asset units. Never `balanceOf`.
  76:     uint256 public reserves;
  77:     /// @notice Buffer floor, in bps of outstanding DNR supply.
  78:     uint16 public bufferFloorBps = 2_000; // 20%
  79: 
  80:     /// @notice Redemption flow caps, in asset units. Zero disables a cap (see FlashGuard._meter).
  81:     uint256 public redeemPerBlockCap;
  82:     uint256 public redeemPerDayCap;
  83:     Flow private _redeemFlow;
  84: 
  85:     /// @notice Addresses permitted to `fund()` - the Alchemist for this market.
  86:     mapping(address => bool) public funder;
  87: 
  88:     event Funded(address indexed from, uint256 assets);
  89:     event Redeemed(address indexed who, uint256 debtIn, uint256 assetsOut);
  90:     event BufferFloorSet(uint16 bps);
  91:     event RedeemCapsSet(uint256 perBlock, uint256 perDay);
  92:     event FunderSet(address indexed who, bool allowed);
  93: 
  94:     error NotFunder();
  95:     error FloorTooLow();
  96:     error ZeroAmount();
  97:     error InsufficientReserves();
  98:     error AssetTransferMismatch(uint256 received, uint256 expected);
  99: 
 100:     constructor(Denari debtToken_, IERC20 asset_, address safe) Ownable(safe) {
 101:         debtToken = debtToken_;
 102:         asset = asset_;
 103:         uint8 d = IERC20Metadata(address(asset_)).decimals();
 104:         require(d <= 18, "asset decimals > 18");
 105:         scale = 10 ** (18 - d);
 106:     }
 107: 
 108:     // �� admin ������������������������������������������������������������������������������������
 109: 
 110:     function setFunder(address who, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {
 111:         funder[who] = allowed;
 112:         emit FunderSet(who, allowed);
 113:     }
 114: 
 115:     function setBufferFloorBps(uint16 bps) external onlyOwner {
 116:         if (bps < MIN_BUFFER_FLOOR_BPS) revert FloorTooLow();
 117:         bufferFloorBps = bps;
 118:         emit BufferFloorSet(bps);
 119:     }
 120: 
 121:     function setRedeemCaps(uint256 perBlock, uint256 perDay) external onlyOwner {
 122:         redeemPerBlockCap = perBlock;
 123:         redeemPerDayCap = perDay;
 124:         emit RedeemCapsSet(perBlock, perDay);
 125:     }
 126: 
 127:     /// @notice Allow an integrator contract to call `redeem`. EOAs always may (FlashGuard L2).
 128:     function setAllowedContract(address who, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {
 129:         _allowedContract[who] = allowed;
 130:     }
 131: 
 132:     // �� the buffer �������������������������������������������������������������������������������
 133: 
 134:     /// @notice Underlying required, in asset units, to consider the buffer healthy.
 135:     function requiredBuffer() public view returns (uint256) {
 136:         return (debtToken.totalSupply() * bufferFloorBps) / BPS / scale;
 137:     }
 138: 
 139:     /// @notice False halts ISSUANCE in the Alchemist. It never halts redemption - see the header.
 140:     function bufferHealthy() external view returns (bool) {
 141:         return reserves >= requiredBuffer();
 142:     }
 143: 
 144:     /// @notice Add underlying backing. Called by the Alchemist on repay/harvest.
 145:     function fund(uint256 assets) external nonReentrant {
 146:         if (!funder[msg.sender]) revert NotFunder();
 147:         if (assets == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
 148:         uint256 balanceBefore = asset.balanceOf(address(this));
 149:         asset.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);
 150:         uint256 balanceAfter = asset.balanceOf(address(this));
 151:         if (balanceAfter < balanceBefore) revert AssetTransferMismatch(0, assets);
 152:         uint256 received = balanceAfter - balanceBefore;
 153:         if (received != assets) revert AssetTransferMismatch(received, assets);
 154:         reserves += received;
 155:         emit Funded(msg.sender, assets);
 156:     }
 157: 
 158:     // �� redemption �������������������������������������������������������������������������������
 159: 
 160:     /// @notice Burn `debtAmount` DNR (18dp) for the same value of underlying (asset dp), 1:1.
 161:     /// @dev    Checks-effects-interactions: reserves fall and the burn happens before the transfer
 162:     ///         out, and `nonReentrant` backstops it. The burn is of THIS contract's own balance
 163:     ///         after pulling the tokens in - see Denari.burn's note on why that matters.
 164:     /// @dev    **No `onlyAllowedCaller` here, and that absence is deliberate.** An earlier cut of this
 165:     ///         contract carried the L2 allowlist on this function, which contradicted its own header:
 166:     ///         most redemption arbitrage is executed BY CONTRACTS, so an allowlist on the redeem path
 167:     ///         would block the peg defense while claiming to protect it. The flow caps below bound a
 168:     ///         drain without gating who may repair the peg - that is the right tool for this path.
 169:     function redeem(uint256 debtAmount) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 assetsOut) {
 170:         if (debtAmount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
 171:         // Round DOWN in the protocol's favour: a redeemer can never extract more underlying than
 172:         // the debt they burned represents. With scale == 1 this is exact.
 173:         assetsOut = debtAmount / scale;
 174:         if (assetsOut == 0) revert ZeroAmount(); // dust below one asset unit would burn for nothing
 175:         if (assetsOut > reserves) revert InsufficientReserves();
 176: 
 177:         _meter(_redeemFlow, assetsOut, redeemPerBlockCap, redeemPerDayCap);
 178: 
 179:         // effects
 180:         reserves -= assetsOut;
 181: 
 182:         // pull the debt in, then burn our own balance (never a third party's - no allowance is
 183:         // checked inside Denari.burn, and this is the reason that is safe)
 184:         IERC20(address(debtToken)).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), debtAmount);
 185:         debtToken.burn(address(this), debtAmount);
 186: 
 187:         asset.safeTransfer(msg.sender, assetsOut);
 188:         emit Redeemed(msg.sender, debtAmount, assetsOut);
 189:     }

   8: /// @title CollateralEscrow - one per (user, market). No co-mingling, ever.
   9: /// @notice Design: `omerta-bank-protocol-design.md` 2.5. This is FiRM's central lesson and the
  10: ///         design records it as "not optional."
  11: ///
  12: ///         �� WHY THIS EXISTS, AND WHY IT DELETES A WHOLE BUG CLASS �����������������������������
  13: ///         Alchemix pools every depositor's collateral into shared yield positions and tracks each
  14: ///         user's claim as internal SHARES. Runtime Verification's finding #1 against that design
  15: ///         was an accounting advantage available to large depositors - the kind of rounding bug
  16: ///         that only exists because a pool has to be divided.
  17: ///
  18: ///         **We do not divide a pool, because there is no pool.** Each user's collateral sits in
  19: ///         their own contract at their own address. Their position is a concrete token balance, not
  20: ///         a fraction of anything. So RV finding #1 is not *fixed* here - it is **unreachable**,
  21: ///         which is a strictly stronger property and the reason the design's own mention of shares
  22: ///         accounting was dropped rather than implemented.
  23: ///
  24: ///         The escrow holds the EXTERNAL yield vault's ERC-4626 shares. Those are that vault's
  25: ///         shares, not ours - one balance, one owner, no internal share price for us to round.
  26: ///         A depositor's realizable value is the growth of fee-aware `previewRedeem` on the shares they alone
  27: ///         hold, so one user's rounding can never move another user's balance: there is no shared
  28: ///         denominator between them.
  29: ///
  30: ///         �� THE TRUST MODEL, STATED PLAINLY ��������������������������������������������������
  31: ///         The escrow is DUMB. It holds tokens and obeys exactly one controller, set once at
  32: ///         construction and never changeable. All policy - loan-to-value, caps, timing - lives in
  33: ///         the Alchemist. That split is deliberate: it means auditing "can a user's collateral be
  34: ///         taken?" is reading this ~90-line file, not the whole protocol.
  35: ///
  36: ///         There is deliberately **no sweep, no rescue, no owner withdrawal**. A sweep is how an
  37: ///         escrow becomes a rug vector, and "recover a mistakenly-sent token" is not worth a
  38: ///         function that can move value out on a non-user's say-so. Tokens sent here directly by
  39: ///         mistake are lost; that is the correct trade for a contract whose entire job is custody.
  40: contract CollateralEscrow {
  41:     using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  42: 
  43:     /// @notice The Alchemist for this market. Immutable - an escrow cannot be re-pointed.
  44:     address public immutable controller;
  45:     /// @notice The user this escrow belongs to. Recorded for off-chain attribution; the contract
  46:     ///         itself never grants this address any authority (all calls come via the controller).
  47:     address public immutable owner;
  48:     /// @notice The underlying collateral asset (e.g. USDC).
  49:     IERC20 public immutable asset;
  50:     /// @notice The external ERC-4626 yield vault the collateral is deployed into.
  51:     IERC4626 public immutable vault;
  52: 
  53:     error NotController();
  54: 
  55:     modifier onlyController() {
  56:         if (msg.sender != controller) revert NotController();
  57:         _;
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     constructor(address owner_, IERC20 asset_, IERC4626 vault_) {
  61:         controller = msg.sender; // the Alchemist deploys these; nothing else can
  62:         owner = owner_;
  63:         asset = asset_;
  64:         vault = vault_;
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     /// @notice Deploy `assets` (already transferred in by the controller) into the yield vault.
  68:     /// @dev    The controller transfers first, then calls. Approving only `assets` each time -
  69:     ///         never `type(uint256).max` - bounds what a compromised vault can take to what we
  70:     ///         just deposited, rather than to everything this escrow will ever hold.
  71:     function deployToVault(uint256 assets) external onlyController returns (uint256 shares) {
  72:         uint256 sharesBefore = vault.balanceOf(address(this));
  73:         asset.forceApprove(address(vault), assets);
  74:         vault.deposit(assets, address(this));
  75:         asset.forceApprove(address(vault), 0); // leave no standing allowance
  76:         uint256 sharesAfter = vault.balanceOf(address(this));
  77:         shares = sharesAfter - sharesBefore;
  78:     }
  79: 
  80:     /// @notice Redeem enough shares to send exactly `assets` of underlying to `to`.
  81:     function withdraw(uint256 assets, address to) external onlyController {
  82:         vault.withdraw(assets, to, address(this));
  83:     }
  84: 
  85:     /// @notice Redeem ALL shares to `to`. Used for a full exit, where asking for an exact amount
  86:     ///         would leave dust stranded behind a rounding step.
  87:     function withdrawAll(address to) external onlyController returns (uint256 assets) {
  88:         uint256 shares = vault.balanceOf(address(this));
  89:         if (shares == 0) return 0;
  90:         assets = vault.redeem(shares, to, address(this));
  91:     }
  92: 
  93:     /// @notice This user's collateral, valued in underlying.
  94:     /// @dev    `previewRedeem` is the vault's executable, fee-aware accounting and is not a price
  95:     ///         feed we read for
  96:     ///         a borrow decision - the market is denomination-matched (2.1), so there is no
  97:     ///         exchange rate in the borrow path at all. This is "how much USDC do my vault shares
  98:     ///         represent", which is the vault's own bookkeeping, not an oracle.
  99:     function totalAssets() external view returns (uint256) {
 100:         return vault.previewRedeem(vault.balanceOf(address(this)));
 101:     }
 102: }
