  92:     /// @param factory_ the reviewed V2 factory that must attest `pair_` as its OMR/WETH market
  93:     /// @param pair_ the canonical OMR/WETH Uniswap V2-compatible pair
  94:     /// @param omr_  the OMR token, so the constructor can work out which side of the pair it is
  95:     ///              rather than trusting a caller-supplied flag
  96:     /// @param weth_ the reviewed wrapped native token; the other side may not be an arbitrary asset
  97:     constructor(
  98:         address owner_,
  99:         IUniswapV2Factory factory_,
 100:         IUniswapV2Pair pair_,
 101:         address omr_,
 102:         address weth_,
 103:         uint32 period_
 104:     ) Ownable(owner_) {
 105:         if (
 106:             address(factory_) == address(0) || address(pair_) == address(0) || omr_ == address(0) || weth_ == address(0)
 107:         ) revert ZeroAddress();
 108:         if (omr_ == weth_) revert SameToken();
 109:         if (period_ < MIN_PERIOD) revert PeriodTooShort();
 110:         factory = factory_;
 111:         pair = pair_;
 112:         omr = omr_;
 113:         weth = weth_;
 114:         PERIOD = period_;
 115: 
 116:         address t0 = pair_.token0();
 117:         address t1 = pair_.token1();
 118:         if (!((t0 == weth_ && t1 == omr_) || (t0 == omr_ && t1 == weth_))) revert NotOmrPair();
 119:         if (factory_.getPair(omr_, weth_) != address(pair_)) revert PairNotCanonical();
 120:         uint8 omrDecimals = IERC20Metadata(omr_).decimals();
 121:         if (omrDecimals != 18) revert UnsupportedTokenDecimals(omr_, omrDecimals);
 122:         uint8 wethDecimals = IERC20Metadata(weth_).decimals();
 123:         if (wethDecimals != 18) revert UnsupportedTokenDecimals(weth_, wethDecimals);
 124:         // price0Cumulative is token1-per-token0. We want OMR per WETH, so we want the cumulative
 125:         // whose NUMERATOR is OMR: price0 when OMR is token1, price1 when OMR is token0.
 126:         omrIsToken1 = (t1 == omr_);
 127: 
 128:         // Seed the first snapshot. `priceAverage` stays 0 until an update closes a full PERIOD, so
 129:         // the oracle reports UNAVAILABLE (not zero-price) for its whole first window.
 130:         (uint256 p0, uint256 p1, uint32 ts) = _currentCumulativePrices();
 131:         priceCumulativeLast = omrIsToken1 ? p0 : p1;
 132:         blockTimestampLast = ts;
 133:     }
 134: 
 135:     /// @notice Close the current window and roll the average forward. PERMISSIONLESS by design -
 136:     ///         gating it on a keeper role would mean a lost key freezes the price feed, and through
 137:     ///         it the bond product. Anyone may poke; nobody can poke it early.
 138:     function update() external {
 139:         (uint256 p0, uint256 p1, uint32 ts) = _currentCumulativePrices();
 140:         uint32 timeElapsed;
 141:         unchecked {
 142:             timeElapsed = ts - blockTimestampLast; // wraps at 2^32, the V2 convention
 143:         }
 144:         if (timeElapsed < PERIOD) revert PeriodNotElapsed(timeElapsed, PERIOD);
 145: 
 146:         uint256 cumulative = omrIsToken1 ? p0 : p1;
 147: 
 148:         // �� THE WINDOW IS BOUNDED ON BOTH SIDES (red-team F2) ����������������������������������
 149:         // Too SHORT is obvious and handled above. Too LONG is the subtle one and it was a real hole:
 150:         // closing a multi-day interval publishes an average of prices that are LONG GONE, and stamps
 151:         // it `lastUpdate = now` - so the consumer's staleness check cannot see it, because that check
 152:         // measures when the average was COMPUTED, not what period it COVERS. Measured on the real
 153:         // contract: after a nine-day keeper outage spanning a bull run that then crashed, this
 154:         // reported 19,998 while spot was 5,000. Four times over, stamped fresh.
 155:         //
 156:         // What made it exploitable rather than merely wrong: `update()` is permissionless, so whoever
 157:         // pokes CHOOSES when the window closes - and after an outage the interval can contain a high
 158:         // price nobody had to pay to create. Ordinary market volatility does the attacker's work.
 159:         //
 160:         // So a too-long interval is DISCARDED, not averaged: re-baseline and report nothing until an
 161:         // honest window closes. Fail-closed, and recovery is one PERIOD.
 162:         if (timeElapsed > PERIOD * MAX_WINDOW_MULT) {
 163:             priceCumulativeLast = cumulative;
 164:             blockTimestampLast = ts;
 165:             priceAverage = 0; // -> consult() reports "no usable reading" -> OmertaBond reverts
 166:             lastUpdate = 0;
 167:             emit Rebaselined(timeElapsed);
 168:             return;
 169:         }
 170: 
 171:         unchecked {
 172:             // The subtraction is deliberately wrapping: V2's cumulatives are allowed to overflow and
 173:             // the DIFFERENCE stays correct across the wrap. This is the one place unchecked maths is
 174:             // load-bearing rather than an optimisation.
 175:             priceAverage = uint224((cumulative - priceCumulativeLast) / timeElapsed);
 176:         }
 177:         priceCumulativeLast = cumulative;
 178:         blockTimestampLast = ts;
 179:         lastUpdate = block.timestamp;
 180: 
 181:         emit Updated(priceAverage, _decode(priceAverage), timeElapsed);
 182:     }
 183: 
 184:     /// @inheritdoc IOmrOracle
 185:     function consult() external view returns (uint256 omrPerEth, uint256 updatedAt) {
 186:         // Reports 0 before the first closed window - the interface's "no usable reading" signal,
 187:         // which OmertaBond turns into a revert. Never a free pass.
 188:         return (_decode(priceAverage), lastUpdate);
 189:     }
 190: 
 191:     /// @dev UQ112x112  OMR-wei per 1e18 ETH-wei. `mulDiv` for the 512-bit intermediate: the naive
 192:     ///      `priceAverage * 1e18` overflows uint256 for large averages (2^224 * 10^18 > 2^256), which
 193:     ///      would silently corrupt the exact reading the mint wall depends on.
 194:     function _decode(uint224 avg) private pure returns (uint256) {
 195:         if (avg == 0) return 0;
 196:         return Math.mulDiv(uint256(avg), 1e18, uint256(1) << 112);
 197:     }
 198: 
 199:     /// @dev The pair's cumulatives brought forward to NOW. A pair only writes its cumulative on a
 200:     ///      touch (mint/burn/swap/sync), so on a quiet pool the stored value lags; V2's own periphery
 201:     ///      does this same counterfactual accrual, and skipping it would silently shorten every
 202:     ///      window by however long the pool sat idle.
 203:     function _currentCumulativePrices()
 204:         private
 205:         view
 206:         returns (uint256 price0Cumulative, uint256 price1Cumulative, uint32 blockTimestamp)
 207:     {
 208:         blockTimestamp = uint32(block.timestamp % 2 ** 32);
 209:         price0Cumulative = pair.price0CumulativeLast();
 210:         price1Cumulative = pair.price1CumulativeLast();
 211:         (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 tsLast) = pair.getReserves();
 212:         if (reserve0 == 0 || reserve1 == 0) revert NoReserves();
 213:         if (tsLast != blockTimestamp) {
 214:             unchecked {
 215:                 uint32 timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - tsLast; // wrapping, per V2
 216:                 price0Cumulative += ((uint256(reserve1) << 112) / reserve0) * timeElapsed;
 217:                 price1Cumulative += ((uint256(reserve0) << 112) / reserve1) * timeElapsed;
 218:             }
 219:         }
 220:     }
 221: }
  71:     event Invalidated(int24 arithmeticMeanTick);
  72:     event BaselineInitialized(int56 tickCumulative, uint32 blockTimestamp);
  73: 
  74:     error PeriodTooShort();
  75:     error PeriodNotElapsed(uint32 elapsed, uint32 required);
  76:     error ZeroAddress();
  77:     error ContractRequired(address target);
  78:     error UnsupportedObservationSource();
  79:     error UnsupportedTokenDecimals(address token, uint8 decimals);
  80:     error PoolNotInitialized();
  81:     error WrongPool();
  82:     error NotObservationSource();
  83: 
  84:     /// @param source_ the exact OmertaHook used by the canonical v4 pool
  85:     /// @param omr_ OMR; native ETH is fixed as currency0 and OMR as currency1
  86:     /// @param fee_ the canonical pool fee committed by the launch configuration
  87:     /// @param tickSpacing_ the canonical pool tick spacing committed by the launch configuration
  88:     /// @param period_ minimum number of chain seconds in one published observation window
  89:     constructor(IOmrV4ObservationSource source_, address omr_, uint24 fee_, int24 tickSpacing_, uint32 period_) {
  90:         if (address(source_) == address(0) || omr_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
  91:         if (address(source_).code.length == 0) revert ContractRequired(address(source_));
  92:         if (omr_.code.length == 0) revert ContractRequired(omr_);
  93:         if (period_ < MIN_PERIOD) revert PeriodTooShort();
  94:         if (!IERC165(address(source_)).supportsInterface(type(IOmrV4ObservationSource).interfaceId)) {
  95:             revert UnsupportedObservationSource();
  96:         }
  97: 
  98:         IPoolManager poolManager_ = source_.poolManager();
  99:         if (address(poolManager_) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
 100:         if (address(poolManager_).code.length == 0) revert ContractRequired(address(poolManager_));
 101: 
 102:         uint8 omrDecimals = IERC20Metadata(omr_).decimals();
 103:         if (omrDecimals != 18) revert UnsupportedTokenDecimals(omr_, omrDecimals);
 104: 
 105:         PoolKey memory key = PoolKey({
 106:             currency0: Currency.wrap(address(0)),
 107:             currency1: Currency.wrap(omr_),
 108:             fee: fee_,
 109:             tickSpacing: tickSpacing_,
 110:             hooks: IHooks(address(source_))
 111:         });
 112:         PoolId poolId_ = key.toId();
 113:         (int56 cumulative, uint32 timestamp, bool initialized) = source_.currentTickCumulative(poolId_);
 114: 
 115:         source = source_;
 116:         poolManager = poolManager_;
 117:         omr = omr_;
 118:         fee = fee_;
 119:         tickSpacing = tickSpacing_;
 120:         poolId = poolId_;
 121:         PERIOD = period_;
 122:         if (initialized) _setBaseline(cumulative, timestamp);
 123:     }
 124: 
 125:     /// @notice Permissionless keeper entry point. The first initialized call seeds a baseline;
 126:     ///         nobody can close a window before a full PERIOD after that baseline.
 127:     function update() external {
 128:         _update(true);
 129:     }
 130: 
 131:     /// @inheritdoc IOmrHookObserver
 132:     /// @dev Called through OmertaHook.pokeObserver after PoolManager settlement. Frequent swap
 133:     ///      notifications simply no-op until a full window is available, avoiding a revert on every
 134:     ///      trade while preserving the strict behavior of the direct keeper entry point.
 135:     function observe(PoolKey calldata key) external {
 136:         if (msg.sender != address(source)) revert NotObservationSource();
 137:         if (PoolId.unwrap(key.toId()) != PoolId.unwrap(poolId)) revert WrongPool();
 138:         _update(false);
 139:     }
 140: 
 141:     /// @inheritdoc IOmrOracle
 142:     function consult() external view returns (uint256 omrPerEth, uint256 updatedAt) {
 143:         return (priceAverage, lastUpdate);
 144:     }
 145: 
 146:     function _update(bool revertIfEarly) private {
 147:         (int56 cumulative, uint32 timestamp, bool initialized) = source.currentTickCumulative(poolId);
 148:         if (!initialized) {
 149:             if (revertIfEarly) revert PoolNotInitialized();
 150:             return;
 151:         }
 152: 
 153:         if (!baselineInitialized) {
 154:             _setBaseline(cumulative, timestamp);
 155:             return;
 156:         }
 157: 
 158:         uint32 timeElapsed;
 159:         unchecked {
 160:             timeElapsed = timestamp - blockTimestampLast;
 161:         }
 162:         if (timeElapsed < PERIOD) {
 163:             if (revertIfEarly) revert PeriodNotElapsed(timeElapsed, PERIOD);
 164:             return;
 165:         }
 166: 
 167:         if (timeElapsed > PERIOD * MAX_WINDOW_MULT) {
 168:             _setBaseline(cumulative, timestamp);
 169:             arithmeticMeanTick = 0;
 170:             priceAverage = 0;
 171:             lastUpdate = 0;
 172:             emit Rebaselined(timeElapsed);
 173:             return;
 174:         }
 175: 
 176:         int56 cumulativeDelta;
 177:         unchecked {
 178:             cumulativeDelta = cumulative - tickCumulativeLast;
 179:         }
 180:         int56 denominator = int56(uint56(timeElapsed));
 181:         int56 meanTick = cumulativeDelta / denominator;
 182:         // Solidity rounds signed division toward zero. Tick TWAPs conventionally round toward
 183:         // negative infinity so a negative fractional tick does not become a more favorable price.
 184:         if (cumulativeDelta < 0 && (cumulativeDelta % denominator != 0)) meanTick--;
 185: 
 186:         int24 meanTick24 = int24(meanTick);
 187:         uint256 price = _omrPerEthAtTick(meanTick24);
 188:         _setBaseline(cumulative, timestamp);
 189:         arithmeticMeanTick = meanTick24;
 190:         if (price == 0) {
 191:             // At an extreme negative tick the 18-decimal quote genuinely rounds below one OMR wei
 192:             // per ETH. Publishing the prior reading as fresh would be unsafe, so invalidate instead.
 193:             priceAverage = 0;
 194:             lastUpdate = 0;
 195:             emit Invalidated(meanTick24);
 196:             return;
 197:         }
 198: 
 199:         priceAverage = price;
 200:         lastUpdate = block.timestamp;
 201:         emit Updated(meanTick24, price, timeElapsed);
 202:     }
 203: 
 204:     function _setBaseline(int56 cumulative, uint32 timestamp) private {
 205:         tickCumulativeLast = cumulative;
 206:         blockTimestampLast = timestamp;
 207:         if (!baselineInitialized) {
 208:             baselineInitialized = true;
 209:             emit BaselineInitialized(cumulative, timestamp);
 210:         }
 211:     }
 212: 
 213:     /// @dev v4 tick price is currency1/currency0 in raw units. Here that is OMR-wei/ETH-wei.
 214:     ///      `mulDiv` supplies the 512-bit intermediate for sqrtPriceX96^2.
 215:     function _omrPerEthAtTick(int24 tick) private pure returns (uint256) {
 216:         uint256 sqrtPriceX96 = uint256(TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tick));
 217:         return Math.mulDiv(sqrtPriceX96, sqrtPriceX96 * 1e18, uint256(1) << 192);
 218:     }
 219: }

 235:             revert InvalidActivationTtl();
 236:         }
 237:         if (block.timestamp < activation.approvedAt) revert ApprovalNotYetValid();
 238:         if (block.timestamp >= activation.validUntil) revert ApprovalStale();
 239:     }
 240: 
 241:     function _validTicker(bytes memory ticker) private pure returns (bool) {
 242:         if (ticker.length == 0 || ticker.length > 24) return false;
 243:         for (uint256 i; i < ticker.length; ++i) {
 244:             bytes1 character = ticker[i];
 245:             bool upper = character >= 0x41 && character <= 0x5A;
 246:             bool digit = character >= 0x30 && character <= 0x39;
 247:             bool punctuation = character == 0x2E || character == 0x5F || character == 0x2D;
 248:             if (!upper && !digit && !punctuation) return false;
 249:         }
 250:         return true;
 251:     }
 252: 
 253:     function _deactivateConflict(bytes32 conflictKey, bytes32 targetKey, uint256 nextCatalogVersion) private {
 254:         if (conflictKey != bytes32(0) && conflictKey != targetKey) {
 255:             _deactivate(conflictKey, CONFLICT_REASON, nextCatalogVersion);
 256:         }
 257:     }
 258: 
 259:     function _deactivate(bytes32 versionKey, bytes32 reasonHash, uint256 nextCatalogVersion) private {
 260:         AssetVersion storage version = _versions[versionKey];
 261:         if (!version.active) return;
 262:         version.active = false;
 263:         version.deactivatedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
 264:         if (activeVersionForTickerHash[version.tickerHash] == versionKey) {
 265:             delete activeVersionForTickerHash[version.tickerHash];
 266:         }
 267:         if (activeVersionForToken[version.token] == versionKey) {
 268:             delete activeVersionForToken[version.token];
 269:         }
 270:         if (activeVersionForProviderIdHash[version.robinhoodAssetIdHash] == versionKey) {
 271:             delete activeVersionForProviderIdHash[version.robinhoodAssetIdHash];
 272:         }
 273:         emit AssetVersionDeactivated(versionKey, reasonHash, uint64(block.timestamp), nextCatalogVersion);
 274:     }
 275: 
 276:     function _isExactlyActive(bytes32 versionKey, AssetVersion storage version) private view returns (bool) {
 277:         return version.active && activeVersionForTickerHash[version.tickerHash] == versionKey
 278:             && activeVersionForToken[version.token] == versionKey
 279:             && activeVersionForProviderIdHash[version.robinhoodAssetIdHash] == versionKey;
 280:     }
 281: 
 282:     function _isLiveBallot(uint256 day, bytes32 versionKey, AssetVersion storage version) private view returns (bool) {
 283:         return _isExactlyActive(versionKey, version)
 284:             && activationGeneration[versionKey] == ballotActivationGeneration[day];
 285:     }

 291:         if (processedSettlements[key]) revert AlreadyProcessed();
 292:         processedSettlements[key] = true;
 293: 
 294:         CreditCalculation memory calculation = _calculateCredit(request.measuredSettlementGas);
 295:         credit = calculation.credit;
 296:         status = calculation.status;
 297:         if (credit != 0) {
 298:             credits[request.executor] += credit;
 299:             totalCreditsRecorded += credit;
 300:             totalOutstandingCredits += credit;
 301:         }
 302: 
 303:         emit SettlementProcessed(
 304:             key, request.eventId, request.victimAccountId, request.victimNonce, request.executor, status
 305:         );
 306:         emit SettlementCreditCalculated(
 307:             key,
 308:             request.measuredSettlementGas,
 309:             calculation.billableGas,
 310:             calculation.reimbursableGasPrice,
 311:             calculation.approvedDataFee,
 312:             calculation.verifiedGasCost,
 313:             calculation.available,
 314:             credit
 315:         );
 316:     }

 319:         amount = credits[msg.sender];

 495:     /// @dev The Safe-selected runtime hash and identity getters prove consistency, not semantic provenance.
 496:     ///      Before proposing, the Safe launch ceremony must independently reproduce and review the successor.
 497:     function proposeMigration(address successor_, uint256 amount, bytes32 reasonHash)
 498:         external
 499:         onlyOwner
 500:         returns (bytes32 proposalId)
 501:     {

 550:         if (migrationProposalState(proposalId) != ProposalState.EXECUTABLE) revert ProposalNotExecutable();

 565:

 604: 
 605:     function _calculateCredit(uint256 measuredSettlementGas)
 606:         private
 607:         view
 608:         returns (CreditCalculation memory calculation)
 609:     {
 610:         if (retired) {
 611:             calculation.status = CreditStatus.ZERO_RETIRED;
 612:             return calculation;
 613:         }
 614: 
 615:         uint256 perSettlementCap = config.perSettlementWeiCap;
 616:         calculation.billableGas = _addCapped(measuredSettlementGas, auditedOverheadGas, type(uint256).max);
 617:         uint256 baseAndPriority = _addCapped(block.basefee, config.priorityFeeCapWei, type(uint256).max);
 618:         calculation.reimbursableGasPrice = tx.gasprice < baseAndPriority ? tx.gasprice : baseAndPriority;
 619:         calculation.approvedDataFee = _approvedDataFee();
 620:         calculation.verifiedGasCost =
 621:             _mulCapped(calculation.billableGas, calculation.reimbursableGasPrice, perSettlementCap);
 622:         calculation.verifiedGasCost =
 623:             _addCapped(calculation.verifiedGasCost, calculation.approvedDataFee, perSettlementCap);
 624:         calculation.available = unreservedBalance();
 625: 
 626:         if (paused()) {
 627:             calculation.status = CreditStatus.ZERO_PAUSED;
 628:             return calculation;
 629:         }
 630:         if (perSettlementCap == 0) {
 631:             calculation.status = CreditStatus.ZERO_CAP;
 632:             return calculation;
 633:         }
 634:         if (calculation.available == 0) {
 635:             calculation.status = CreditStatus.ZERO_UNFUNDED;
 636:             return calculation;
 637:         }
 638: 
 639:         calculation.credit =
 640:             calculation.verifiedGasCost < calculation.available ? calculation.verifiedGasCost : calculation.available;
 641:         calculation.status = calculation.credit < calculation.verifiedGasCost ? CreditStatus.PARTIAL : CreditStatus.FULL;
 642:     }
 643: 
 644:     function _approvedDataFee() private view returns (uint256) {
 645:         Config memory currentConfig_ = config;
 646:         address source = currentConfig_.dataFeeSource;
 647:         if (source == address(0) || source.codehash != currentConfig_.dataFeeSourceRuntimeCodeHash) return 0;
 648: 
 649:         bytes memory callData =
 650:             abi.encodeWithSelector(ISettlementDataFeeSource.currentTransactionNativeDataFee.selector);
 651:         bool success;
 652:         uint256 reportedFee;
 653:         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 654:             success := staticcall(DATA_FEE_SOURCE_CALL_GAS, source, add(callData, 32), mload(callData), 0, 0)
 655:             if and(success, eq(returndatasize(), 32)) {
 656:                 returndatacopy(0, 0, 32)
 657:                 reportedFee := mload(0)
 658:             }
 659:             if iszero(eq(returndatasize(), 32)) { success := 0 }
 660:         }
 661:         if (!success) return 0;
 662:         return reportedFee < currentConfig_.dataFeeWeiCap ? reportedFee : currentConfig_.dataFeeWeiCap;
 663:     }

 665:     function _cancelLiveConfigProposal(bytes32 cancellationReasonHash) private {
 666:         bytes32 proposalId = liveConfigProposalId;
 667:         ProposalState state = configProposalState(proposalId);
 668:         if (state != ProposalState.WAITING && state != ProposalState.EXECUTABLE) return;
 669: 
 670:         configProposals[proposalId].cancelled = true;
 671:         liveConfigProposalId = bytes32(0);
 672:         emit ConfigProposalCancelled(proposalId, cancellationReasonHash);
 673:     }

 675:     function _validateDataFeeSourceConfig(Config memory config_) private view {
 676:         address source = config_.dataFeeSource;
 677:         if (source == address(0)) {
 678:             if (config_.dataFeeSourceRuntimeCodeHash != bytes32(0) || config_.dataFeeWeiCap != 0) {
 679:                 revert InvalidDataFeeSourceConfig();
 680:             }
 681:             return;
 682:         }
 683:         if (config_.dataFeeWeiCap == 0) revert InvalidDataFeeSourceConfig();
 684:         if (source.code.length == 0) revert InvalidDataFeeSource();
 685:         if (source.codehash != config_.dataFeeSourceRuntimeCodeHash) revert DataFeeSourceCodeHashMismatch();
 686:     }

 688:     function _validateProposedConfig(Config calldata nextConfig)
 689:         private
 690:         view
 691:         returns (bytes32 baseConfigHash, bytes32 nextConfigHash)
 692:     {
 693:         _validateDataFeeSourceConfig(nextConfig);
 694:         Config memory oldConfig = config;
 695:         baseConfigHash = _configHash(oldConfig);
 696:         nextConfigHash = _configHash(nextConfig);
 697:         if (baseConfigHash == nextConfigHash) revert NoConfigChange();
 698: 
 699:         bool sourceChanged = oldConfig.dataFeeSource != nextConfig.dataFeeSource
 700:             || oldConfig.dataFeeSourceRuntimeCodeHash != nextConfig.dataFeeSourceRuntimeCodeHash;
 701:         bool capIncreased = nextConfig.priorityFeeCapWei > oldConfig.priorityFeeCapWei
 702:             || nextConfig.perSettlementWeiCap > oldConfig.perSettlementWeiCap
 703:             || nextConfig.dataFeeWeiCap > oldConfig.dataFeeWeiCap;
 704:         if (!sourceChanged && !capIncreased) revert ConfigIncreaseRequired();
 705:     }

 723:     function _deriveProposalId(uint256 nonce, bytes32 baseConfigHash, bytes32 nextConfigHash, bytes32 reasonHash)
 724:         private
 725:         view
 726:         returns (bytes32)
 727:     {
 728:         return keccak256(
 729:             abi.encode(
 730:                 "OMERTA_SETTLEMENT_GAS_POOL_CONFIG_V1",
 731:                 supportedChainId,
 732:                 address(this),
 733:                 nonce,

 737:                 block.timestamp

 741: 
 742:     /// @dev This on-chain check cannot protect against Byzantine Safe semantics or a purpose-built facade.
 743:     ///      Off-chain review must cover source/compiler/settings/runtime, non-delegation, immutable identity,
 744:     ///      current and pending ownership, paused state, and the exact acceptMigration behavior.
 745:     function _validateMigrationSuccessor(address candidateAddress) private view {
 746:         address latchedSuccessor = successor;
 747:         if (latchedSuccessor != address(0) && candidateAddress != latchedSuccessor) {
 748:             revert SuccessorAlreadyLatched();
 749:         }
 750:         if (candidateAddress.code.length == 0) revert InvalidMigrationSuccessor();
 751: 
 752:         ISettlementGasPoolMigrationCandidate candidate = ISettlementGasPoolMigrationCandidate(candidateAddress);
 753:         if (
 754:             candidate.version() != version() || candidate.supportedChainId() != supportedChainId
 755:                 || candidate.gameplayVault() != gameplayVault || candidate.predecessor() != address(this)
 756:                 || candidate.owner() != owner() || !candidate.paused()
 757:         ) revert InvalidMigrationSuccessor();
 758:     }
 759: 
 760:     function _deriveMigrationProposalId(
 761:         uint256 nonce,
 762:         address successor_,
 763:         bytes32 successorRuntimeCodeHash,
 764:         uint256 amount,
 765:         bytes32 reasonHash,
 766:         uint64 proposedAt,
 767:         uint64 executableAt,
 768:         uint64 expiresAt
 769:     ) private view returns (bytes32) {
 770:         return keccak256(
 771:             abi.encode(
 772:                 "OMERTA_SETTLEMENT_GAS_POOL_MIGRATION_V1",
 773:                 supportedChainId,
 774:                 address(this),
 775:                 nonce,
 776:                 successor_,
 777:                 successorRuntimeCodeHash,
 778:                 amount,
 779:                 reasonHash,
 780:                 proposedAt,
 781:                 executableAt,
 782:                 expiresAt
 783:             )
 784:         );
 785:     }
 786: 
 787:     function _addCapped(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 cap) private pure returns (uint256) {
 788:         if (a >= cap || b >= cap - a) return cap;
 789:         return a + b;
 790:     }
 791: 
 792:     function _mulCapped(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 cap) private pure returns (uint256) {
 793:         if (a == 0 || b == 0) return 0;
 794:         if (a > cap / b) return cap;
 795:         uint256 product = a * b;
 796:         return product > cap ? cap : product;
 797:     }
